【Identity连续性强制规则，优先生效】
主角：24岁年轻男性，利落黑色短发，清晰五官，双眼皮，冷白皮肤，固定面部特征，全程五官不能变形、不能换脸；
服装：深灰色修身西装，白色内搭衬衫，黑色西裤，皮鞋，版型固定，服装款式、颜色全程不变，不自动换衣服；
配角（如有）：22岁女生，浅棕色长卷发，米白色针织连衣裙，妆容清淡，五官固定；
【画风&光影统一规则】
8K超写实，UE5电影级渲染，院线质感，柔和电影侧光，低饱和度电影调色，轻微胶片颗粒，景深虚化；
禁止：夸张美颜、卡通化、五官扭曲、肢体畸形、画风突变、服装变色；
【镜头&连续性规则】
保持人物身份识别优先，镜头切换允许机位变化、动作变化，不强制完全复刻上一帧动作；
人物视线逻辑合理，肢体动作自然，手部结构正确；
音频：台词口型尽量匹配，情绪贴合画面；
室内轻奢办公室，傍晚，主角独自站在落地窗前，背对着镜头，缓缓转头看向镜头，神情冷淡凝重，缓慢呼吸，身体轻微静止，氛围压抑安静，缓慢推镜，运镜平稳。
#Dialogue：（低声，沉重）他们还是找到我了。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>, defined by the fused multi-view character design sheet. He has a slim build, pale skin, short neat black hair parted slightly at the forehead, and clear facial features including prominent double eyelids. In the reference, he wears a black suit jacket, a black button-up shirt, black dress trousers, and black dress shoes.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video features <Subject 1> standing alone in a dim, light luxury office at dusk. Initially facing a floor-to-ceiling window with his back to the camera, he slowly turns his head to look directly at the lens with a cold, solemn expression. He speaks a heavy line of dialogue as the camera executes a continuous, slow push in, ending on his tense, staring face.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the target video preserves his clear facial features, double eyelids, short neat black hair, pale skin, and slim build from the fused multi-view reference board, but explicitly replaces his source black suit jacket and black shirt with the requested dark grey slim-fit suit, white inner shirt, and black trousers.

detailed_description:
The target video is in an 8K hyper-realistic cinematic style with low saturation, soft cinematic side lighting, light film grain, and a shallow depth of field.

[Shot 1] The shot begins in a spacious, dimly lit light luxury indoor office during the evening, featuring a massive floor-to-ceiling window that dominates the background. Outside the window, the blurred city skyline is bathed in the fading, cool tones of dusk. The camera performs a steady, deliberate, and slow Push In, maintaining a heavy, atmospheric presence. <Subject 1>, a young man with short neat black hair, pale skin, and a slim build, stands alone in the midground. He is initially positioned with his back completely facing the camera, gazing out through the large glass panes into the twilight city. He is elegantly dressed in a tailored dark grey slim-fit suit jacket, a crisp white inner button-up shirt, and dark black dress trousers, perfectly matching the upscale environment. The overall atmosphere is incredibly quiet and oppressively tense.

As the camera continues its slow push toward his back, <Subject 1> remains rigidly still, his posture tense. The only initial movement is his back slowly rising and falling with deep, controlled, and heavy breaths, conveying a profound sense of psychological weight. The soft cinematic side lighting catches the fine texture of his dark grey suit fabric and the sharp contour of his shoulders. Gradually, breaking the stillness, he slowly begins to turn his head over his right shoulder to look back. The motion is incredibly measured and deliberate. As his face comes into view, the evening light reveals his clear facial features, his double eyelids, and a cold, chillingly solemn expression. There is no trace of panic, only a grim, hardened resolve. He makes direct eye contact with the camera lens, his gaze piercing through the shallow depth of field.

The young man (S1), his voice deep, gravelly, and emotionally heavy, speaks directly to the viewer, <d>[Chinese] 他们还是找到我了。</d>

Immediately after the final word leaves his mouth, his lips press together into a tight, uncompromising line, and his jaw muscles visibly clench. He does not turn back to the window; instead, he completely shifts his torso slightly to the side, fully locking his body's orientation toward the camera. He maintains the chilling, unwavering gaze, his chest expanding as he takes another slow, ragged breath in the quiet room. The camera maintains its relentless slow push in, gradually tightening the framing on his cold, shadowed face as the ambient dusk light outside fades further, leaving him engulfed in the heavy, oppressive silence until the video concludes.

overall_soundscape:
The soundscape features a quiet, oppressive room ambience, accompanied by the slow, heavy breathing of the protagonist and a single line of low, solemn dialogue, with no other distracting noises.

non_diegetic_music:
A subtle, low-frequency cinematic drone that sustains a tense and oppressive atmosphere, with no rhythmic percussion or swelling melodies.
